title: Greek Village Salad
description: A classic Greek salad made with tomatoes and a tangy dressing, perfect for a light and refreshing meal.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine the diced tomatoes, sliced red onion, pitted olives, and crumbled feta cheese.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the salad dressing ingredients.
3. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
5. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
6. Just before serving, garnish with fresh parsley or dill.
